_why: CI v2 step 9 (cmuxterm-hq#16502): with on=true every same-repository Mac pull request job runs on the per-run label the controller grants, cmux-<run_id>-<run_attempt>-mac (plus xcode-<version>), not a glaeda pool. Flip only once every PR mini runs an asker: no standing runner carries the label. It moves the jobs behind simple_pool_picker.py (ci.yml, ci-macos.yml, remote-daemon.yml); the Mac workflows with no picker (auth-refresh-tests, billing, cloud-command-deadlines, cloud-machine-tests, cloud-task-local-tests, iroh-v2, relay-tls, terminal-hang-diagnostics) move to the grant label inline in the pull request that flips this. scripts/ci/mac_grants.py reads this file.
